quote: ODATA, an Aligned Data Centers Company (“ODATA” or the “Company”), a leader in the construction and operation of data centers in Latin America, today announced a US $1.02 billion green financing focused on sustainable data center infrastructure investments. … It will support the Company’s growth across key regional markets — Brazil, Mexico, Chile, and Colombia.
note: Opened Aligned Data Centers English press release 2026-10-04.
